classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. The included lower endpoint −5 is the least member.

content.prompt:
Let $A$ be a subset of $\mathbb R$. Define the following.
$$\begin{aligned}\max A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\ge a\text{ for any }a\in A\\\min A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\le a\text{ for any }a\in A\end{aligned}$$
Find $\min[-5,7]$.

answer.worked: The closed interval includes $-5$, and every member is at least $-5$. Thus $\min[-5,7]=-5$.
